title: Trailblaze Nueva Ecija Marathon 2026 Review: Palayan City's Rice-Bowl 42K
seo_title: Trailblaze Nueva Ecija Marathon 2026 Review | Philippines
meta_description: Trailblaze Nueva Ecija Marathon 2026: August 30 in Palayan City. A full marathon from TNER in the Philippines' rice-bowl province.
dek: Set for 30 August 2026 in Palayan City, Nueva Ecija — the Philippines' rice-bowl province — this TNER marathon brings a full 42K to Central Luzon's agricultural heartland.
verdict: The Trailblaze Nueva Ecija Marathon brings a full marathon to Palayan City — the capital of Nueva Ecija, the Philippines' 'Rice Granary' province in Central Luzon. Organised by TNER, it offers a flat course through the province's vast rice plains. Nueva Ecija is predominantly agricultural with a flat terrain that promises fast running. August is the wet season in Central Luzon. For runners wanting a Philippine full marathon in an under-represented agricultural province, this is a distinctive pick.

sections.heading: Nueva Ecija: The Rice Granary
paragraphs: Nueva Ecija is the Philippines' premier rice-producing province — flat, agricultural, with wide roads through rice plains. [1] Palayan City is the provincial capital. TNER handles local race production. The flat terrain makes for a fast marathon course.
